name: 2 · Farm plan evidence: chase → verify → sign off

parameters.content:
## 2 · Farm plan evidence: chase → verify → sign off
Weekly: ask each provider for what is missing, remind after 7 days, and stop at 3 requests so a person can phone.
A person verifies every upload. When a farm is complete the agent drafts the pack from verified records only. The owner signs it off, and only then does it go to the certifier.
The checklist and the due date are settings: when the rules move, change them once and every open pack follows.

### Mondays 08:00 NZ (or from the console): chase the evidence
Never messages the same person about the same item twice in 24 hours, and stops at three requests.

### Provider opens the upload link
From their phone: a PDF or a photo, no login.

### Provider uploads the evidence
Stored under files/evidence and marked "check needed". The farm manager is asked to verify. Nothing is trusted until a person has looked at it.

### Farm manager verifies or sends back (console button)
Verified: when the last item on a farm is verified, the agent drafts the pack and asks the owner to sign. Sent back: the provider gets the reason and a fresh link.

### Open the evidence pack (read-only)
The page the certifier gets a link to: every item, who supplied it, who verified it, and what happened.

### Owner opens the sign-off page
The pack, and a sign-off form that only appears once every item is verified.

### Owner signs off: only now does anything go to the certifier
Needs the owner's full name and a confirmation. The email to the certifier, and the record of who signed and when, happen after this click and not before.

### View an uploaded evidence file
The pack token proves the file belongs to that pack.

### The checklist changes: add a requirement (console form)
It becomes an open item on every farm it applies to, and any pack that was ready or already sent is reopened. Nothing is lost: every earlier record stays.

### The due date moves (console form)
One setting. Every countdown, message and pack uses it.

meta.description: Chases the people who hold each piece of evidence, lets the farm manager verify uploads, drafts the evidence pack when a farm is complete, and sends it to the certifier only after the owner signs it off.
